intended_use: Research-only metabolic deviation and representation learning.
not_intended_for: future disease probability without longitudinal validation

run_manifest.determinism_note: Seeded NumPy/torch generators, CPU by default. The torch backend on Apple Silicon mps is not bit-for-bit reproducible; see https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/randomness.html

output_vocabulary.metabolic_deviation_score: How unusual a metabolic profile is versus the training reference.
output_vocabulary.reference_percentile: Rank of that deviation score within the training reference distribution.
output_vocabulary.latent_representation: 16-dimensional learned encoding of the input features.
output_vocabulary.cross_sectional_association: Association with an already-present condition. Not future risk.

capabilities.warning: No patient-level longitudinal outcomes: do not describe scores as future disease risk.

score_distribution.combined_sorted_note: Deployment copy: the reference distribution is an 8001-point quantile grid of the full 44128-row training reference distribution (percentile resolution 0.0125 pp). Weights, preprocessor and score definition are unchanged.

any_cancer_prevalence.warning: This does not measure future disease development.

type2_diabetes_proxy.warning: This does not measure future disease development.

type1_diabetes_proxy_research_only.reason: Fewer than 50 cases in one class on the holdout partition.

posthoc_association_note: Cross-sectional associations with already-present conditions on the holdout partition. These are NOT future-risk performance.
